title: Natural stationary-page comparison for maps of CE sections totals
statement: Natural stationary-page comparison for maps of CE sections totals. Fix any family D(X,K) of termwise presentations [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation], and any realizations e of their positive page objects [def-sp-spectral-sequence] as the actual cycle/boundary cokernels [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential]. EtaleCEQuotientRealization names this family of isomorphisms. For maps b of their sections totals [lem-weil-pbc-ce-total-sections-comparison] and spectral-sequence maps N, EtaleCEPageMapOnRepresentatives means that, for any abelian-group test object A and maps x,y from A to the respective q-th filtration steps in degree q+p, with b(x)=y, and maps z,zprime to the graded r-cycle subobjects whose inclusions are the graded classes of x,y, the page class of z followed by N equals the page class of zprime. There exist bounds R(X,K,q,n) and comparisons eInf from page r at (q,n-q) to the q-th graded piece of D.H n [def-sp-filtration], whenever r>=1 and R<=r. For every filtered sections-total map b and N obeying the representative equation, there exist step maps t and ht restricting c_X^{-1}H^n(b)c_Y. Past both stationary bounds, eInf intertwines N with cokernel.map(t_(q+1),t_q), for every proof of the successive-inclusion square. The assertion does not mention f,v, a sheaf-total lift, or ordinary first-page cohomology.

proof.text: Using D.below, extension by zero, and D.filtration_formula, derive degreewise finite tails of D.L: it is top at the complex-degree lower bound b and bottom at n+1 in degree n. For fixed q,n choose R at least 1 making q+R past the upper tail in n+1 and q-R+1 below the lower tail in n-1. These inequalities persist on all later pages.

Construct the transported homology-image epimorphisms by actual image factorizations and D.H_formula. Apply the local stationary-cycle comparison at each bidegree and bound. Its representative and homology equations uniquely determine the chosen comparison; compose with e and transport the total-degree equality to obtain eInf.

For an arbitrary filtered chain map b, apply homology to its step restrictions. The inclusion square induces maps on their images; transport by the two c-isomorphisms to obtain t and ht. Cancelling target step inclusions also proves compatibility with successive inclusions.

Apply EtaleCEPageMapOnRepresentatives to genuine cycle representatives in step q. The canonical projections of these representatives to the stationary page and the successive homology-image quotient are epimorphic. After transporting the image maps by c, cancellation gives exactly the displayed cokernel.map square. Its commutativity proof is irrelevant. No CE augmentation, inverse-image map, or ordinary first-page comparison is involved.

theorem exists_etaleCE_stationary_page_comparisons
    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
      EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K)
    (e : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
      EtaleCEQuotientRealization (D X K)) :
    ∃ (R : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (q n : ℤ), ℤ)
      (eInf : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (q n r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hR : R X K q n ≤ r),
        ((D X K).sequence.page r hr).X (q, n - q) ≅ ((D X K).H n).gradedPiece q),
      ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{uNatural}}
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (b : (D X K).sectionsTotal ⟶ (D Y L).sectionsTotal)
        (N : (D X K).sequence ⟶ (D Y L).sequence),
        (∀ q : ℤ, ∃ s : ((D X K).L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} ℤ) ⟶
            ((D Y L).L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} ℤ),
          s ≫ ((D Y L).L.step q).arrow = ((D X K).L.step q).arrow ≫ b) →
        EtaleCEPageMapOnRepresentatives (D X K) (D Y L) (e X K) (e Y L) b N →
          ∀ n : ℤ,
            ∃ (t : ∀ q : ℤ, (((D X K).H n).step q : AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}) ⟶
            (((D Y L).H n).step q : AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
          (ht : ∀ q : ℤ, t q ≫ (((D Y L).H n).step q).arrow =
            (((D X K).H n).step q).arrow ≫
              (((D X K).c n).inv ≫
                HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
                  b n ≫ ((D Y L).c n).hom)),
          ∀ (hc : ∀ q : ℤ,
            Subobject.ofLE (((D X K).H n).step (q + 1)) (((D X K).H n).step q)
                (((D X K).H n).antitone_step (Int.le_add_one (le_refl q))) ≫ t q =
              t (q + 1) ≫
                Subobject.ofLE (((D Y L).H n).step (q + 1)) (((D Y L).H n).step q)
                  (((D Y L).H n).antitone_step (Int.le_add_one (le_refl q)))),
          ∀ (q r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hX : R X K q n ≤ r) (hY : R Y L q n ≤ r),
            (N.hom r hr).f (q, n - q) ≫ (eInf Y L q n r hr hY).hom =
              (eInf X K q n r hr hX).hom ≫
                cokernel.map
                  (Subobject.ofLE (((D X K).H n).step (q + 1)) (((D X K).H n).step q)
                    (((D X K).H n).antitone_step (Int.le_add_one (le_refl q))))
                  (Subobject.ofLE (((D Y L).H n).step (q + 1)) (((D Y L).H n).step q)
                    (((D Y L).H n).antitone_step (Int.le_add_one (le_refl q))))
                  (t (q + 1)) (t q) (hc q)
